::: {.callout-note}
## Conflicting or unsettled dates
Public later sources disagree about **1993** versus **1994** as a CSIL starting year. The inspected 2008 ministry-commissioned synthesis says only “the 1990's.” A 2006 Health Canada report says the program had existed “for the past twenty years.” This page does not choose among those wordings.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can separate, with citations:

- program design and ministry authorization
- a pilot
- province-wide availability
- later retrospective start dates

Those may be different events. They should not be merged in prose until sources are inspected.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts from inspected 1990s ministry files:** none. Original instruments remain [wanted](../sources/wanted-ministry-csil-pilot-records.qmd).
- **Later 1993 claim:** [IFRC / SCI deck](../sources/ifrc-sci-presentation-1993.qmd).
- **Later 1994 claims:** [IFRC Module 1](../sources/ifrc-csil-module-1-1994.qmd); [Kelly et al. 2020](../sources/kelly-2020-directly-funded.qmd); IFRC Our Team (Cheng biography).
- **Later unspecified 1990s:** [2008 synthesis](../sources/wanted-2008-program-review.qmd).
- **Later “twenty years” as of 2006:** [Spalding et al.](../sources/spalding-2006-self-managed.qmd).
- **Open questions:** what “start” refers to in each later account; which records survive; what the pilot’s scope was.
